title: Juicy Adventurous Chinese Smoked Haddock Stir-fry
description: An earthy and adventurous Cantonese dish featuring smoked haddock in a savory stir-fry sauce that is both healthy and jain-friendly.

ingredients.name: Smoked Haddock Fillets
ingredients.notes: Ensure the fish is smoked at a safe temperature, not exceeding 165°F (74°C) to preserve its texture and flavor.

ingredients.name: Garlic Cloves
ingredients.notes: Mince finely for maximum aroma and flavor.

ingredients.name: Chili Peppers, Finely Chopped (Optional)
ingredients.notes: For an extra kick, finely chop 1-2 chili peppers.

ingredients.name: Fresh Ginger Slices
ingredients.notes: Grate or thinly slice for a robust ginger flavor.

ingredients.name: Shallots, Finely Chopped (Optional)
ingredients.notes: Add to enhance the stir-fry's depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: Jade Pepper (Optional)
ingredients.amount: A pinch (for color, not as a spice)

instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and optional chili peppers; sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant but not browned.
If using shallots, add them now and stir-fry briefly until translucent.
Carefully add smoked haddock fillets skin-side down to the pan. Let cook undisturbed for about 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
Stir in ginger slices; gently toss everything together.
If using canned black beans, add them now and stir-fry until heated through (about 1-2 minutes).
Season with salt to taste. If desired, sprinkle a pinch of jade pepper over the top for color appeal.
Cook remaining shallots or optional jade pepper if added in earlier steps for about 30 seconds.
Finally, add more vegetable oil if needed and stir-fry any fresh herbs or additional seasonings if using (e.g., soy sauce, rice vinegar), adjusting to your desired level of umami.
Turn off heat and immediately serve hot with steamed rice. Serve with extra ginger slices on the side for dipping into the sauce.
